careers.headline: Build the Future With Us
careers.subheadline: Join a team of passionate engineers, designers, and product thinkers who are building technology that matters.

benefits.title: High Impact Work
benefits.description: Work on products used by thousands of people. Your code ships to production and makes a real difference.

benefits.title: Great Team
benefits.description: Work alongside talented, humble, and driven people who care deeply about craft and quality.

benefits.title: Rapid Growth
benefits.description: We are growing fast. There is enormous opportunity to take ownership and grow your career quickly.

benefits.title: Remote Friendly
benefits.description: We believe great work can happen anywhere. Flexible work arrangements for the right candidates.

benefits.title: Learning Budget
benefits.description: Dedicated budget for courses, conferences, books, and anything that helps you grow professionally.

benefits.title: Health & Wellness
benefits.description: Comprehensive health coverage and wellness programs to keep you at your best.

hiringProcess.title: Apply
hiringProcess.description: Submit your application with your resume and a brief note about why you want to join.

hiringProcess.title: Screening
hiringProcess.description: A 30-minute call with our team to learn about you and share more about the role.

hiringProcess.title: Technical
hiringProcess.description: A practical technical assessment relevant to the role you are applying for.

hiringProcess.title: Interview
hiringProcess.description: In-depth conversations with the team to assess culture fit and technical depth.

hiringProcess.title: Offer
hiringProcess.description: We move fast. If it is a great fit, you will receive an offer within days.

openPositions.title: Senior Angular Developer
openPositions.description: Build world-class web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies.

openPositions.title: Senior .NET Developer
openPositions.description: Design and build scalable backend APIs and services using .NET, C#, and Azure.

openPositions.title: Flutter Developer
openPositions.description: Create beautiful, performant cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.

openPositions.title: Product Designer
openPositions.description: Design intuitive, beautiful product experiences from concept to pixel-perfect implementation.

programs.title: Graduate Program
programs.description: A structured 12-month program for fresh graduates to learn, grow, and contribute to real products from day one.

programs.title: Internship Program
programs.description: 6-month internships for students who want to gain real-world experience building production software.
